title: Employment Income Deductions
text: For employment income, a statutory deduction equal to one-third of total gross salary or Tk 500,000, whichever is lower, shall be exempted under Section 32.

title: Investment Tax Rebate Rules
text: Tax rebate is calculated at 15% on allowable investments up to 20% of total taxable income or Tk 1 Crore, whichever is lower. Maximum allowance for Deposit Pension Scheme (DPS) is Tk 120,000 annually.

title: Withholding Tax & SRO Provisions
text: Special tax treatment and tax deduction at source rules for payments subject to withholding under Finance Act 2026.
